2014_spells.shape-water.description: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways: You instantaneously move or otherwise change the flow of the water as you direct, up to 5 feet in any direction. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage. You cause the water to form into simple shapes and animate them as you like. This change lasts for 1 hour. You change the water's color or opacity. The water must be changed in the same way throughout. This change lasts for 1 hour. If you target water in a container, you cause the water to create a whirlpool. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is strong enough to unbalance a Small or smaller creature that tries to cross it. This change lasts for 1 hour.
2014_spells.shape-water.effectSummary: Create a magical area that affects creatures inside it
2014_spells.shape-water.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage; You manipulate it in one of the following ways: You instantaneously move or otherwise change the flow of the water as you direct, up to 5 feet in any direction. This change lasts for 1 hour.
